title: Truth was here before your urgency
summary: Truth precedes the fear trying to rule this moment. Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
takeaway: Return the hand to trust before it closes again.
lifeApplication: Before tightening around the outcome again, stop, name what is already here, and release one demand you cannot faithfully carry.

source.shortMeaning: Truth precedes the fear trying to rule this moment.
source.lifeApplication: Before reacting, remember that Truth did not begin with this scene.

evidence.coreClaim: Truth precedes the fear trying to rule this moment.
evidence.turn: Carry this with you: truth is not won by pressure or wit, but by walking in Hukam.
